d: Andhra Pradesh has attracted investments totalling ₹9.89 lakh crore following the two-day 31st CII Partnership Summit in Visakhapatnam, according to Vizianagaram MP Kalisetti Appalanaidu. He said the State’s investment drive was being linked to poverty alleviation through Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu’s Public-Private-People Partnership (P4) model.
